thesis: CDNA is a high-beta (2.487), extended momentum name being bought into a risk-off tape (QQQ below 50- and 200-day, 21-day -9.57%, VIX 20.85 and rising) that is hitting growth and tech hardest. Price already sits above the technical entry zone (close 84.42 vs zone 81.5-84.0), 14.4% above SMA20, after a roughly +390% run in 126 days, so a buyer is chasing a post-earnings gap. Valuation is rich (forward P/E 53.5, P/S 8.9, EV/EBITDA 164) while growth is slowing sequentially and reported profit is flattered by a non-recurring Q2. The news and SEC feeds were down, so offering risk and the cause of the gap and the 11% drop on 2026-11-05 are unverified; a stock this extended is a classic candidate for an equity raise or a gap fill.
